name: 06033 · Glastonbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06033 (Glastonbury) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06033 (Glastonbury) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06033 (Glastonbury) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
